evidence.reason: The preview path checks at lines 909-912 only test each path against the checkout/deploy root, not against the resolved --output root. If --output/systemd is a symlink to the live systemd unit directory, it is outside the checkout and passes line 911; render_units then follows that symlink at line 922 and writes into the live directory. The same applies to launchd. The intended preview output is confined to --output, so each resolved child should be required to remain inside the resolved --output before any write.
